title: Maximize The Topmost Element After K Moves
description: Find the maximum possible top element of the stack after exactly k moves.
pseudocode:
1. if k == 0 return nums[0]
2. if k == 1 return nums[1]
3. if n == 1 and k % 2 != 0 return -1
4. max_val = max(nums[0...k-2])
5. if k < n return max(max_val, nums[k])
6. return max_val

steps.note: Initialize max_val by checking elements reachable before k moves.
Update max_val with the next accessible element.
Check if k < n to consider the element at index k.
Return the final maximum value found.
